floorPlans.renderTool: PDFium at 5600px per spread, lossless separation of complete printed pages, lossless WebP delivery
floorPlans.introduction: Explore the original residence drawings. Each choice shows a complete printed page, with full-size zoom and the original PDF spread.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a residence layout and level
floorPlans.note: The 17 choices preserve complete printed plan pages from physical PDF spreads 45–53. Duplex and townhouse levels repeat the whole-home total. Penthouse B is printed as 3,215 sq ft, beyond the brochure’s rounded marketing range. Original drawings and notices are retained. Confirm the exact current unit with Deyaar.

review.imagery: 15 visually reviewed project-specific images, including three actual developer construction-update photos. Image descriptions distinguish photographs and proposed renders. No card badges.
review.plans: The 17 choices preserve complete printed plan pages from physical PDF spreads 45–53. Duplex and townhouse levels repeat the whole-home total. Penthouse B is printed as 3,215 sq ft, beyond the brochure’s rounded marketing range. Original drawings and notices are retained. Confirm the exact current unit with Deyaar. The original 5600px PDF spreads were divided losslessly at the printed-page boundary. Every complete page retains its original content, footer and notices. Each link points to its physical source spread.
review.location: Deyaar’s local Dubai Silicon Oasis map marks Tria within the neighbourhood. It does not establish a surveyed visitor entrance. review.provenance: Original PDF, source hashes, fetch receipts and visual numerical panel reviews are retained in artifacts/project-page-enhancement/tria/. IDs, ownership and original text research are preserved.
